contracts.evidence: Advect dt multiplies velocity divided by texture dimensions; texels per caller time unit and matching dt are algebraically accurate. Gradient centered pressure differences are multiplied by supplied half_inverse_cell_size; its 1/(2*dx) comment states caller frame convention, not enforcement. Divergence differences adjacent texture cells and applies caller half_inverse_cell_size; unit-spaced grid describes texel-coordinate neighbors, not proof of SI or unit coefficient. No fluid caller establishing stricter physical policy was supplied.
contracts.disposition: No numeric or unit policy introduced. If future owner adds physical-spacing claims, coefficient/velocity frame must be made explicit.
